column1: # Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice (Ninja Theory), base game 1.1.0, Unreal Engine 4 (a version 4 pak with its shaders inline in the cooked packages and the global shader cache), SDK 7.3.0, NVN.
# Profile made from a survey of the user's own .nup (read in place, no extraction); bring-up and on-device validation are still open. See README.md.
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (main imports from it); load order main, subsdk*, sdk.
# Provisional Unreal values from the survey: nninitStartup reserves a 62 GB address region and its allocator takes part of it.
# The rewriter's engine-wide gate (dm/tools/ue_region.py) gives the region what the alias area has room for; refine on a real boot.
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# One version 4 pak (HellbladeGame-Switch.pak, 50,337 files, no compression) with no shader code archives: the shaders are inline
# in the cooked packages and in Engine/GlobalShaderCache-GLSL_SWITCH.bin (LSLG records, Zlib), as in early Unreal Engine 4.
# Unreal combines vertex and pixel shaders per draw, so the split pairs each vertex shader with a pixel-input cover.
